summary: Redact API keys/tokens from transport-layer error strings and RateLimitError.URL
reason: Secondary-source HTTP clients (OpenFDA, PubMed, OpenAlex) embed api_key query params in URLs. When requests fail, source.go's error handlers exposed these keys in logs. Central scrubURL() helper now redacts sensitive params (api_key, apikey, api-key, key, token, access_token, auth) across all 7 error sites.

files.description: Added scrubURL() helper (lines 215–222); applied at decodeInto (line 54) and 6 sites in do() (lines 71, 77, 85, 95, 115, 122). Ensures API keys never escape transport layer to logs.
